statement_fidelity.machine_checked_postcondition: Eight ideal-membership identities in a free associative algebra prove the two-tail annihilation, flat-line, orbit-to-commutator, arbitrary-word induction, and all-grade-piece preservation implications in every finite dimension. A block identity proves rank preservation from kernel containment. Together with the stated Hodge curvature and orthogonal-grading interpretation, the first two null curvatures force every tail curvature to vanish.

statement_fidelity.quantifiers: The local common-kernel assertion applies to every polarized complex pure variation on any complex manifold and every holomorphic highest-piece line on the constant-rank locus, with no bound on the lengths or ranks of the tails. The associated geometric theorem retains every h and compatible algebraic line in prop:tail-rank and every rational c0,c1>0, cj>=0 for j>=2, and t>=0, and proves nu(Pc+tH)=nu(Pc)=nu(L0+L1).
